status: Proposed - local supporting workflow, implementation not authorised

model.kind: deterministic seven-stage process model in renderer NODES/EDGES
model.editing_model: import-workflow.drawio contains editable labelled process blocks; exports regenerated from renderer source
model.source_and_export_relationship: Renderer is the reproducible authority for this bundle; draw.io is separately editable. Manual draw.io edits are not automatically reflected in SVG/PNG/GIF. Reconcile edits into renderer before re-export.
model.architecture_boundary: Supporting import workflow only; not AWS/system architecture, not an alternative phase DAG and not a replacement for canonical Lucid diagrams.

alt_text: Proposed import workflow, not implemented or live telemetry. Seven ordered stages: Receive original; Validate or quarantine; Extract candidates; Match and normalise; Owner preview and approval; Commit and financial audit; Durable receipt and reconciliation. Trace, source, status and cost evidence applies at every stage. Failed, cancelled or staged work has no financial visibility. Financial visibility is permitted only after a successful logical commit. Static PNG and SVG alternatives are available.

animation.purpose: Slow focus walkthrough of seven proposed stages, not live telemetry
animation.default: Use static PNG/SVG by default; opt-in animation button,restore static to stop
animation.reduced_motion: Host must suppress automatic playback and use static when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce
animation.embedded_gif_note: GIF cannot enforce reduced-motion by itself; host owns the opt-in control
animation.loop: repeats while host chooses GIF; 12.6 second cycle
animation.flashing: No flicker; one bounded focus change every 1.8 seconds
animation.palette: Shared across all frames to keep unchanged regions stable

validation.text_fit: passed for every process title/body line
